---
title: Code block style, one outline around a filename block (idiomatic)
format:
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
    syntax-highlighting: idiomatic
_quarto:
  tests:
    typst:
      noErrors: default
---

A code block with a filename must have one outline, drawn by the filename frame.
The code block inside the frame must not draw its own outline.

```{=typst}
#show block: it => {
  let s = it.stroke
  let drawn = s != none and not (type(s) == dictionary and s.values().all(v => v == none))
  if drawn { counter("cbs-outline").step() }
  it
}
```

```{.python filename="example.py"}
x = 1
```

```{=typst}
#context assert.eq(counter("cbs-outline").final().first(), 1, message: "expected one outline around the filename block")
```
